scope: All 408 marked complete examples in the guide and the tutorial, each run against the built Rust compiler with clang: every `run` example is checked, built, and executed with its recorded exit status and stdout, every `check` example must pass the checker without linking, and every `reject` example must fail checking with the recorded message fragment. This is not the full compiler regression suite.
